theme: A travel day — I-95 south, calendar clear.
greeting: The calendar's empty and you're pointed south, Dan — a driving day more than a working one. The only things with teeth are a couple of overdue bookings where waiting actually costs money.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental is still open
needsAttention.detail: Your one p1 on the Mike + Dan board — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, since the Pathfinder is south by then. Open since mid-September; that rental is the hardest in the Portland market over the holidays and it sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break has no destination picked
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30, book-by was Oct 15 — both behind you now. Six people over three weeks at the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, and every day narrows it.

schedule.title: Southbound on I-95
schedule.detail: Overnight at the Spark by Hilton in Fredericksburg, VA

flagged.title: You're on the NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The organizers sent the agenda for the Oct 28 New England event to the group and you're cc'd. Nothing owed yet, but worth a skim before next week — it's squarely in your governance world.

flagged.title: Board-practice partner nudged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A second ping from someone in a CEO & Board of Directors search practice — the kind of search-side contact worth answering given the board hunt.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail, LinkedIn job alerts, and local real-estate pings.
inbox.clear: No one is blocked on a reply from you this morning.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in — roots, squash, and slow-cooked warmth.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: An early start cleared the packing and travel prep; nothing formal on the books.
The calendar holds nothing straight through — a driving afternoon.
You stop in Virginia for the night, roughly the midpoint of the Portland-to-St Pete run.
